title: Gogot blink black screen (half) 5-10 times , and crash macOS system.
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible : 4.4stable , 4.4.1stable, 4.5dev-all
- NOT reproducible : 4.3stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev4 - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads)

### Issue description

crash macOS system, Yes , and mac restart, all system.

- blinking black screen (half) 5 - 10 times and crash macOS
- 1 blink in one action , this cumulate in time , one hour later (10-12 blink) mac full black blink and some pink, and crash system macOS


### Steps to reproduce

this happend in my tests in 2 situations, I see this 2 situations

Firs situation :

1. select any image  imported to resources , must be big like *.exr , or big *.png , 10MB-20MB  
2. go to.  import tab
3. set any change , (losses -> basis universal , or somting else)
4. click reimport
5. BLINK - black screen - fast - NO crash
6. if select 10-20 images and this do , may long black BLIBK - and may crash system


Second situation :

1. Works on compute shader file , 
2. change code in VS Code
3. back to Godot , godot compile compute shader - BLINK black screen - no crash
4. again change code, repeat 10-20 times , 
5. one hour later - change code - back to godot - godot TRY compile compute 
6. and FULL BLACK blink + some pink ? , crash macOS system

This do 3 - 5 times per day for me :( this crash macOS 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I test on godot  4.4 stable , 4.4.1stable. ,4.5dev :
- create empty project , 
- import image .png , .exr ( big image better)
- go to import tab, change somting
- reimport 
I see blink black screen  (half) ( fast )

or :
- import compute shader file, 
- change it,
- go to Godot, godot compile it
I see blink black screen (half) (fast)


I doing this  test in godot 4.3stable.
- not happend, not black blink screen , no crash
